campaign-record.description: Native optimization-campaign record: iterations, candidates with per-task outcomes, matrix tasks, gate verdict.

run-record.description: Workflow run telemetry: workflowProgress phase and agent entries.

ActionArgument.comment: One typed argument on a workflow route action. Queryable replacement for JSON cargo in retained workflow-book faces.

AuthorizationFlag.comment: A retained record that an explicit authorization boundary applied to a visible workflow-book route or choice.

AuthoringSession.comment: An event-log backed workflow authoring session. Mutating compose/apply gestures append wf:CompositionEvent records and fold them into the authored workflow definition subject.

wf:boundToAgent.source: wf:AuthoringSession -> agt:Session projection edge; inverse agt:realizedBy is materialized on the Agent side

wf:definitionSubject.source: the workflow definition subject this session folds into

CompletenessGap.comment: A derived authoring gap for an incomplete workflow draft. It is query-time guidance, not authoritative stored workflow RDF.

CompositionEvent.comment: One durable authoring gesture from workflow_book_compose/workflow_book_apply. Events are the write path; derived drafts are read projections over these records and the current workflow definition.

wf:boundToAgent.source: wf:CompositionEvent -> agt:Turn projection edge; inverse agt:realizedBy is materialized on the Agent side

wf:definitionSubject.source: the workflow, phase, or agent-node subject this event folds into

wf:deltaJson.source: machine-readable patch or normalized compose plan delta

wf:insertTriple.source: canonical RDF triple inserted into the folded workflow definition cache

wf:deleteTriple.source: canonical RDF triple deleted from the folded workflow definition cache

Draft.comment: The read-derived authoring perception of a workflow under construction, folded from the definition subject plus CompositionEvent records.

DraftWarning.comment: A derived non-blocking authoring warning for a workflow draft.

EvidenceArtifact.comment: A retained sidecar artifact that grounded a workflow-book page-turn decision: handoff, transcript, preflight, page audit, or another externally inspectable evidence file.

NavigationRoute.comment: A named workflow-book route over one exact page choice, retained either with a PageView or a PageTurnDecision.

Operation.comment: One published workflow-facing API operation. Materializes to an OpenAPI paths/{path}/{method} PathItem through the OpenAPI face; legacy api:Operation remains a compatibility alias.

Parameter.comment: One input parameter on a workflow-facing API operation. Materializes to an OpenAPI operation parameter entry.

Response.comment: One response variant from a workflow-facing API operation. Materializes to an OpenAPI operation responses map entry.

Server.comment: A server hosting the workflow-facing API. Materializes to an OpenAPI top-level servers entry.

WorkflowBinding.comment: The workflow invocation seam. Links a wf:Operation to a Choreograph workflow and carries verbatim JSON Schema literals for the OpenAPI face; legacy api:WorkflowBinding remains a compatibility alias.

wf:bindsWorkflow.source: Canonical executable workflow subject; required by the live invocation face, optional only for legacy publication records.

wf:capability.source: Named host-mediated capabilities; credentials never enter the execution sandbox.

wf:controller.source: Canonical execution controller: program, agent, or composite.

wf:definitionDigest.source: Pinned sha256 of the executable workflow definition; required by the live invocation face.

wf:effects.source: pure or capability-bound; independent of controller and model use.

wf:executor.source: Compatibility projection only: gated or dumb. Canonical execution posture is carried by the orthogonal facets.

wf:modelUse.source: none, inference, or agentic; an agentless transcription operation may still use inference.

PageView.comment: A retained workflow-book page view: source-side page perception, visible routes, exact raw SPARQL, retained recommendation snapshot, and authorization boundary.

PageTurnDecision.comment: A retained workflow-book page-turn Meaningful Object: what Garden suggested, which named route/choice was recommended or followed, why, which artifacts grounded it, and whether execution was explicitly authorized.

prov:value.source: short rationale safe to show; not chain-of-thought

wf:followedRouteId.source: the named route the agent actually followed when this decision records an accepted turn

wf:hasNavigationRoute.source: links to retained wf:NavigationRoute nodes that were visible on the origin page

RawSparqlQuery.comment: One exact raw SPARQL query retained with a workflow-book PageView.

RecommendedAction.comment: A retained recommendation snapshot inside an immutable PageView. Live workflow_book_open recommendations are virtual resolve-by-query opinions, not authoritative stored facts.

RouteAction.comment: The typed, queryable action behind a retained workflow-book route. This replaces wfui:actionJson as the semantic representation.

wf:seededFrom.source: archetype, template, or prior workflow element used to seed this agent node

AgentRun.comment: EXACT names — the frontend joins on these. wf:partOfRun, never wf:run (the v0.1 drift the emitter made unrepresentable).

wf:boundToAgent.source: wf:AgentRun -> agt:Turn binding edge; inverse agt:realizedBy is derived

wf:node.source: AgentNode doc URI when the label maps to a node

dcterms:title.comment: safe: urn subject, not a doc

wf:seededFrom.source: template or prior phase used to seed this phase

Phase.subject_rule: uri_rules.phase (urn space — fragment subjects are forbidden)

Protocol.comment: The pinning subject of a distributed commons seed: protocol version plus the vocab version/sha/registry-URL anchor. Offline resolution: trust the seed's snapshot, verified against wf:vocabSha256.

wf:vocabRegistry.source: URL of the registry serving the live contract

wf:vocabSha256.source: sha256 of the canonical vocab JSON bytes at that version

wf:vocabVersion.source: version of the vocabulary contract the seed pins

wf:boundToAgent.source: wf:Run -> agt:Session binding edge; inverse agt:realizedBy is derived

wf:campaignKind.comment: set (e.g. 'gepa') when this Run is an optimization campaign — the lens discriminator

wf:gateVerdict.source: pass | fail | hold — the pre-registered holdout gate

wf:journalDocument.source: doc URI of the uploaded journal artifact

wf:runRecordDocument.source: doc URI of the stored run record

wf:targetArchetype.source: archetype doc URI the campaign optimized

wf:taskModel.source: the model all candidate scores were measured ON — scores do not transfer across models

RunStatistics.comment: A read-derived workflow statistics face over retained runs, agent runs, and page-turn decision history.
RunStatistics.derived_from_query: workflow_book.runStatistics(wf:Run, wf:AgentRun, wf:PageTurnDecision history for workflow)

Variant.comment: One candidate in an optimization campaign's population. wf:variantText carries the full text as a literal so the frontend can diff against a parent WITHOUT a doc-content fetch path (cap ~8KB).

prov:wasDerivedFrom.source: parent variant doc URI (absent on seed)

wf:holdoutScore.source: holdout score — typically only seed + best are measured

wf:variantText.source: the candidate prompt text (also the sealed block bytes)

Variant.subject_rule: variant doc URI (the doc holds the candidate text in a sealed code block)

wf:description.source: meta.description — wf:description, NOT dcterms (doc subjects are materializer co-managed)

wf:scriptBlock.source: code-block URI <docUri>#<blockId> from write_document block ids

wf:scriptSha256.source: sha256 of the fenced script bytes

wf:seededFrom.source: template, archetype, or prior workflow used to seed this workflow

LiveRecommendedAction.comment: A live workflow_book_open recommendation derived from the current page choices and retained PageView query basis. It is never authoritative stored RDF; retained snapshots use wf:RecommendedAction.
LiveRecommendedAction.derived_from_query: workflow_book_open.intentRecommendation(current page choices, navigation routes, retained PageView recommendation rows)

comment: NEVER write comanaged-prefix predicates on doc subjects — the materializer owns them and re-materialization clobbers (exception: mnemo: via create_wires; dcterms: on urn-space subjects like Phase is safe). rdf:type on doc subjects: adding wf classes is tolerated, but discovery must key on wf:name presence, not type alone.
description: Graph-stored agent workflow definitions, anatomy, run provenance, archetype registry, and optimization campaigns. Aligned with PROV-O.
name: workflow
title: Mnemosyne Workflow Vocabulary

uri_rules.forbidden: NEVER mint subjects in document-fragment space (<docUri>#…) — the content materializer wipes #-subjects on re-materialization. Block URIs may appear as OBJECTS only (wf:scriptBlock, wf:textBlock).
uri_rules.workflowDoc: resolved from the graph (SELECT doc URI by doc id) — NEVER constructed by hand

derivedFrom.comment: custom predicate URI — create_wires accepts non-builtin URIs; the 3D panel renders any wire

exemplifies.source: judgment archetype assignment; ALSO best variant doc -> target archetype doc (campaign winner)
